mood.label: RISK-OFF
mood.summary: U.S. markets are set for a cautious open after the long weekend, with surging oil prices and rising geopolitical tensions weighing on sentiment and pushing Treasury yields higher.

indicesNarrative: Futures indicate a weak and divergent open, with the Dow significantly lagging while the Nasdaq holds flat to slightly green. Surging crude oil prices and a rising 10-year yield are creating headwinds for the broader market, suggesting a risk-off tone as traders return.
